name: Brave Search MCP
tagline: Privacy-respecting web search for your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Brave Search MCP server. Gives your agent the ability to run real web searches with a privacy-first index. Replaces the old auto-reply search for current events, docs, and news.
longDescription:
## What it does

Exposes the Brave Search API (and optionally Brave News, Images, Videos) as MCP tools. Your agent can run a search, get ranked results, fetch the top results, and synthesize an answer.

## Why we recommend it

Brave's index is independent of Google/Bing, has excellent freshness, and includes local and news search. The MCP wrapper is well-maintained by the Brave team.

## Requirements

- Free Brave Search API key (2,000 queries/month free)
- Pay-as-you-go above that, very cheap ($3 per 1,000 queries)
installInstructions:
1. Get a free API key at https://brave.com/search/api/
2. Set `BRAVE_API_KEY=your-key` in your environment
3. Run the install command
4. Optional: enable local search, news, or image results via env vars
pricingDetails: Free tier: 2,000 queries/month. Paid: $3 per 1,000 queries.
